result:
I've read all seven inputs in full. Approved: none of the remaining defects blocks the current data. This approves the code only; it does not accept any source reading or export. I checked by hand that the nine units in data.json reproduce their image readings under their declared selections. I also checked that the five canonical sections in expanded_order declare exactly the same features as the matching units. The two medium findings are real gaps in the code, but nothing in the current data triggers either one.
